preanalysisOverride: 2026-09-29 explicit user request supersedes previous no-automatic-analysis clauses: in paste-order screen, visible/nearby actionable messages are prepared sequentially with existing authenticated Claude parse-paste API, at most 20 automatic calls per page lifetime. Hidden/offline/saving/unmounted queued work does not start. Each page owns an exact raw text + full year/week 15-minute in-memory cache, capped at 100 completed entries, no cross-user/global persistence. Pending identical calls are shared. Explicit retry/analysis remains available beyond automatic budget. Right pane shows real matched Customer.CustName and Product.ProdName, quantity and match/review state. This is NOT ERP application evidence; original exact request/audit display remains in a separate expandable section. Opening a prepared result reuses only exact nonexpired data, then reloads existing mappings and live ERP quantities. No automatic draft replacement, lease takeover, order/distribution/stock writes or application marking.
customerGroupingOverride: 2026-09-29: Within each single source message, group contiguous same-company primary rows under one company heading and keep one compact product/quantity/status row per request. Preserve source order, all quantities, audit status, request IDs, full raw message and cross-year scope. Group by valid exact CustKey when available, otherwise exact displayed company name for presentation only; never infer application from grouping. API-only unpaired rows remain individually unconfirmed in a default-collapsed additional-review section with an always-visible count, separate from the primary applied/total count. No parser, matching, ERP write or quantity aggregation changes.
compactDisplayOverride: 2026-10-05 user clarification: show the entire organized Kakao source message in the left pane, with no ellipsis or per-line truncation. On the right show only applicable company/product/quantity entries and a clear color status. Green applied evidence may come from exact sourceIdentity + unique parsed request ID, or—when audit sourceIdentity differs—a unique one-to-one exact match on selected OrderYear+OrderWeek, numeric CustKey+ProdKey, action, input quantity and canonical input unit, with committed audit timestamp after the source message. One audit entry cannot be reused by duplicate source messages. Missing, partial, duplicate, ambiguous, incomplete, undone, or unverified evidence is amber 미확인; do not infer 미적용 from absent evidence. Keep detailed ERP comparison evidence collapsed. Preserve exact immutable raw source text for parser line IDs; no fuzzy text/name matching. Manual message-level markers are not item-level evidence. Keep inbox within its pane and stack at 1100px and below. No ERP write changes.
actionableList: 2026-09-15 user override: default work list requires quantity plus explicit add/cancel or equivalent signed change. Delivery-only requests, generic chat, stock tables and stock annotations (검역, 취소분) are not work items. Actual explicit changes remain included even with stock wording. Stock/review controls are inside a default-collapsed reference menu; originals are never deleted. Entire raw message is visible before grouped rows, including title action and shipping notes. Verbose technical matching reasons remain only in expanded evidence. Major-week headings preserve their action but do not invent a subweek. This supersedes older compact/expanded-only original and visible-reason wording.
defaultPeriod: KST today inclusive recent seven calendar days. Preserve manual dates, show period even when tools are folded. Changing source period never changes ERP year/week or hides unconfirmed requests. Historical periods remain selectable within the existing seven-day API limit.

requestBalanceComparison.default: all change requests, including matched requests; stock-only and classification review have separate counted tabs
requestBalanceComparison.advisory: Manual applied markers are separate. No status blocks existing ERP operations.
requestBalanceComparison.display: Compact request, corresponding operation, and matching badge share one row. Original text and quantity/stock details expand explicitly. Snapshot is not proof of prior completion.

liveHistoryPairing.source: Read-only OrderHistory and ShipmentHistory are advisory evidence. Both API parsing and displayed line IDs use the identical immutable raw source text; parsed line request ID suffix uses its 1-based index among non-empty source lines.
liveHistoryPairing.partialCoverage: Keep every locally parsed visible change on screen. Pair only a unique exact returned request ID; API omissions remain visible as unconfirmed, API-only requests remain visible as unpaired, duplicate IDs are never paired, and AMBIGUOUS outranks evidence-match labels.
liveHistoryPairing.notCompletion: Generic history, partial history, manual source confirmation, and message-level committed operations do not by themselves prove each item was applied. A unique verified committed audit entry may show item-level 적용. Additionally, the user-approved quantity heuristic may show green 수량확인 only for a unique exact-source parsed request with one unambiguous numeric ShipmentHistory candidate, matching ADD/CANCEL direction and normalized requested quantity. This heuristic is quantity evidence, not fuzzy product-name matching; incomplete or ambiguous evidence remains amber 미확인.
liveHistoryPairing.appliedItemStatus: Prefer exact sourceIdentity + unique raw-line request ID to match verified committed entries. When the operation audit carries a different source identity, allow a fallback only if there is a unique one-to-one exact match in selected OrderYear+OrderWeek, numeric CustKey+ProdKey, ADD/CANCEL direction, exact input quantity and canonical input unit, and the committed audit time is after the source message. Never reuse one operation entry across visible source messages. Duplicate candidates, unverified/incomplete/undone records, approximate source time, unresolved parser requests, or any field mismatch remain amber. The approved quantity heuristic remains limited to its exact-source, unique numeric ShipmentHistory criteria. Every parsed item must be applied by exact identity, this unique exact-content fallback, or the approved quantity heuristic before the source card is auto-confirmed/highlighted; partial coverage highlights only matched item cards. This is key-based audit matching, not fuzzy text/name/quantity matching.
liveHistoryPairing.layout: 1920x1080 full organized Kakao message on the left, succinct company/product/quantity items and color-only application status on the right; detailed ERP evidence remains collapsed; inbox list stays within its allocated pane and scrolls internally; stack left/right panes at 1100px and below
liveHistoryPairing.polling: visible online screen only, one global newest-200-message read-only pairing batch so event claims do not split across pages; older rows are explicitly out of range; scope and identity response validation; last-good preservation
liveHistoryPairing.matchedProjection: Do not apply AI-reconstructed text to the live-history parser: its source-line indexes may differ. AI matching and ERP write paths remain independent.

pairedRequestDensityOverride: 2026-10-05 user clarification: present the complete organized source Kakao text as one left-side pane. Present only corresponding company, product, quantity and green applied / amber unconfirmed item cards on the right; detailed ERP reasons/events are collapsed. The full source message is never truncated. Use exact sourceIdentity/request ID first; if it differs, allow only the unique one-to-one exact business-key/action/input-quantity/unit fallback defined in liveHistoryPairing, plus the separately approved exact quantity-history criteria. All ERP write behavior remains unchanged.

criteria.room: 영업방 exact name + server-configured room ID
criteria.upstream: dedicated authenticated /api/kakao/nenova-sales-feed only; no legacy unauthenticated fallback
criteria.cursor: afterKey is an external_message_id string of at most 512 characters with no control characters; initial cursor is an empty string, it is URLSearchParams-encoded, and nextAfterKey is a valid cursor string or null (null requires hasMore=false)
criteria.messageId: upstream message id may be null; source identity remains source + chat_id + external_message_id
criteria.selection: explicit user text replacement; the row-level prepared-analysis action skips only the redundant replacement confirmation, loads the selected message and opens paste analysis using prepared results; it never commits order or distribution. ERP writes remain behind the separate reviewed register/distribute action
criteria.applicationStatus: one scoped batch GET joins only exact sourceIdentity values from the separate manual-application ledger, at most 20 saved audit snapshots, and verified committed paste-operation audit entries; the read may wait up to 30 seconds. MATCHING_HISTORY, partial evidence, no history, and a checklist REVIEWED event never assert application completion
criteria.manualApplication: manual apply/not-apply/clear are explicit append-only private ledger events with request UUID retry and current-event CAS; no message-index matching or ERP write
criteria.period: KST calendar dates converted to timezone-aware ISO, maximum7days
criteria.duplicates: source message identity de-duplication, never equals ERP committed
criteria.file: UTF8 Kakao export .txt <=2MiB, no external execution

crossYearFixture.description: Message text does not silently change selected ERP year/week; selected year explicit.

autoRefresh.initial: default-open inbox automatically GETs KST recent seven days including today only when year/week are valid, visible, online and no active ERP analysis/save
autoRefresh.scope: same loaded KST period only; date edits retain and label prior rows until explicit reload
autoRefresh.cursor: restart bounded period scan to catch late-arriving lower lexical message IDs
autoRefresh.preserve: input drafts, selected messages and review snapshots; stage incoming changes only while selection or review is open, otherwise display newest incoming rows immediately
autoRefresh.failure: preserve same-scope last good rows and show loading/failure/empty/incomplete status; no automatic LLM or ERP mutation
autoRefresh.concurrency: one in-flight request per scope; explicit refresh during pending work queues one follow-up; status failure backs off up to240seconds; new source and successful ERP operation refresh immediately
